description: An external script that inspects, and may modify or reject, every job as it is submitted.

One element per configured verifier. The element holds both the configuration (where the script is and how to run it) and the live state of the running script process, because a verifier is kept alive across jobs rather than started per job.

attributes.name: name
description: The verifier's name, unique within its context.

attributes.name: context
description: Where this verifier runs: in the submit client, or in qmaster. The list is searched by context.

attributes.name: url
description: The configured location of the script, as written in the JSV configuration.

attributes.name: type
description: How the script is to be started, derived from the URL.

attributes.name: user
description: The user the script runs as, when the configuration asks for one other than the caller.

attributes.name: command
description: The resolved path of the script to execute.

attributes.name: pid
description: Process id of the running script, as a string, for logging and for killing it.

attributes.name: in
description: `FILE *` writing to the script's stdin - how the job is sent to it.

attributes.name: out
description: `FILE *` reading the script's stdout - how its verdict comes back.

attributes.name: err
description: `FILE *` reading the script's stderr, logged as JSV output.

attributes.name: has_to_restart
description: Set when the configuration changed under a running script, so it is restarted before the next job.

attributes.name: last_mod
description: Modification time of the script file when it was started. Compared on each use, so an edited script is picked up without a reconfiguration.

attributes.name: send_env
description: The script asked for the job environment as well as the job itself. Off by default because the environment can be large.

attributes.name: old_job
description: `lListElem *` to the job as submitted, so the changes the script asks for can be applied to a copy.

attributes.name: new_job
description: `lListElem *` to the job the script may modify. This is what is submitted if the verifier accepts.

attributes.name: restart
description: The script asked to be restarted. Ends the current conversation.

attributes.name: accept
description: The script accepted the job. Read together with JSV_done to tell acceptance from a script that died mid-conversation.

attributes.name: done
description: The script sent its closing command. The read loop runs until this is set.

attributes.name: soft_shutdown
description: The script asked to be shut down cleanly after this job rather than killed.

attributes.name: test
description: Verify the script's own answers against an expected sequence, used by the JSV tests rather than in production.

attributes.name: test_pos
description: How far through the expected sequence the test has got.

attributes.name: result
description: The last result string the script sent, kept for the test comparison and for the error message.
